summary: Corrected a recorded premise that my own newest evidence refines. Knowledge 29e4214f5ee146b393957fa23a33a73d-knowledge-2 previously said the automatic snapshot cadence keeps the committed range above the snapshot near SnapshotThreshold; the default-configuration receipt measures 12001 entries above an absent snapshot with the threshold at 8192 and no snapshot taken (receipt 0cb30b6bf8874d479b83653bd4e6c553, event 36), because runSnapshots evaluates shouldSnapshot only when a randomized timeout of up to SnapshotInterval expires (snapshot.go:71-95). Revision 2 states that the range can pass the threshold and keep growing between checks, with the defaults spelled out; the correction lists the seven interpretation IDs that relied on the earlier wording as affected uses, which the controller propagates to the investigation. The replay-completion account gained a successor interpretation that cites the corrected revision, opens with a correction note explaining the measured margin and why it differs from 'near the threshold', and leaves its executions, conclusion, counterevidence (including the burst-workload caveat) and limitations unchanged. Both this and the configuration-recovery account's remaining limitations are structural to the harness rather than statements my evidence contradicts.
